paras: Ancylodactylus dickersonae, also known commonly as Dickerson's forest gecko, Dickerson's gecko, and the four-lined forest gecko, is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Africa.
The specific name, dickersonae, is in honor of American herpetologist Mary Cynthia Dickerson.
A. dickersonae is found in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Uganda.
The preferred natural habitat of A. dickersonae is forest, at elevations of 400–2,200 m (1,300–7,200 ft).
